chunks: Yunus, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
If a Muslim kills a Jew, a Christian, or a Magian, and they want to exact qisas, they shall return the excess of the Muslim’s diyah, and then qisas shall be carried out upon him.

key_terms.فَضْلَ دِيَةِ ٱلْمُسْلِمِ: the excess amount of the Muslim’s blood-money over that of the victim
key_terms.قَتَلَ: killed; caused the death of another person
key_terms.مَجُوسِيًّا: a Magian/Zoroastrian, included in the ruling
key_terms.نَصْرَانِيًّا: a Christian, as one of the protected non-Muslim groups mentioned
key_terms.يَهُودِيًّا: a Jew, as one of the protected non-Muslim groups mentioned
key_terms.يُقِيدُوا: to exact qisas; to seek retaliatory execution
key_terms.ٱلْمُسْلِمُ: the Muslim offender in this legal ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on qisas if a Muslim kills a Jew, Christian, or Magian in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning qisas when a Muslim kills a non-Muslim from among the protected communities mentioned. It states that if the victim’s side seeks retaliation, they must first return the difference between the Muslim’s diyah and the victim’s diyah, after which qisas is carried out.
